diagnosis.saturated_resource: issue-bound Q8 reconstruction ALU (gk_uniform_extract 8-iteration bit loop), with occupancy starvation as a co-limiter on organs with fewer than ~2k rows
not: memory-bound: uncompressed f32 at the SAME 1-thread/row launch reaches 402 GB/s on qkvz and 545 GB/s on lm_head, at or above this-run control 440 GB/s and the 411.51 honest ceiling
register-pressure-bound: every shipped mixed/gk pipeline reports max_total_threads_per_threadgroup=1024, thread_execution_width=32, static_threadgroup_memory=0 (tg256 kernels use 32 B reduce)
pure occupancy-bound on the byte mass: qkvz launches 48 threadgroups (occ proxy 0.80) and lm_head 594 (occ proxy 9.89); both still sit at 16 GB/s shipped

regime_split.large_Q8_qkvz_lm_head_gqa_q: reconstruction/issue. Uncompressed same-launch is 6-9x faster in time and 16-34x in packed-GB/s. Occupancy is already enough for f32 serial to hit the ceiling.
regime_split.medium_Q8_out_2048x4096: reconstruction first (6.8x vs f32 serial), occupancy second (f32 serial only 67 GB/s; f32 coalesced 616 GB/s). This organ alone is 163 ms/token at 2.55 GB/s — the number that matches the 2.57 whole-token figure.
regime_split.small_Q8_ba_router_shared_kv: occupancy + reconstruction. 64-512 rows launch 1-2 threadgroups. ba is 4.9 MB and 56 ms/token (0.09 GB/s).
regime_split.binary_gate: occupancy/access, NOT reconstruction. Binary serial is FASTER in wall time than f32 serial (63 us vs 192 us) because it moves 28x fewer bytes. Packed 2.35 GB/s is the 2-threadgroup launch, same as Q4 serial.
regime_split.hgravs_R_160x512: occupancy-starved (160 threads, 1 TG) plus 3-bit extract. 0.16 GB/s, 100 ms/token across 480 downs.

token_attribution_isolated_gpu_ms.method: isolated organ median GPU ns * count per token. Missing routed-up (~38 ms from prior 80 us isolated). Sum 817.6 + 38 = 856 vs wall gpu_matvec 863.4.

fix_lane_premise.stated_in_Q80_MIXED_RECONSTRUCTION_WALL: mixed codecs (binary / rice_q1 / low-rank) need expensive per-weight reconstruction; that is why mixed is 5.9x slower per byte than Q4
fix_lane_premise.verdict: CONTRADICTED as stated. The 863 ms is not binary/rice/hgravs reconstruction on routed experts.
fix_lane_premise.why: Attention+lm_head+shared+router are HGRAVU01 q8 and are dispatched through q80_hgravs01_factor_matvec / gk_matvec_hgravs, whose serial extract walks 8 bits per byte. Routed mixed organs are ~23% of GPU time (and down-R is occupancy, not decode). Binary gate is faster in us than uncompressed f32 at the same launch.
fix_lane_premise.their_actual_code_is_closer: q80_uniform8_matvec_tg256 / simd_bytes is the right kernel. Keep that. Do not spend the lane on binary/rice fusion as the 863 ms lever.

diagnosis.gk_vs_q80: gk_matvec_binary and gk_matvec_hgravs match q80_* serial to within noise on every organ. The merge did not change the limiter.
